nodes.name: When Called
nodes.notes: Inputs: model output (completion, model, cost_pln) + routing fields (clickup_task_id, reviewer_user_id, triggering_comment_id, web_sources).

nodes.name: Is @mention?
nodes.notes: True (triggering_comment_id set) -> reply in-thread. False (autonomous trigger) -> new top-level comment.

nodes.name: Post Reply
nodes.notes: Reply path for @mention triggers. onError=continueErrorOutput -> Alert Reply Failed, then fallback to Post Draft Comment.

nodes.name: Alert Reply Failed
nodes.notes: WARN when replying in-thread fails. Run continues via Post Draft Comment fallback.

nodes.name: Record Artifact
nodes.notes: ADR-044 erasure-readiness: writes the posted ClickUp comment id onto the task's latest agent_runs row. Side branch off Set Status success — cannot affect the already-complete reply/status. CTE always returns one row (target_id, updated 0/1) so a 0-row UPDATE is detectable, not a silent 0-item drop. Block 10: also records run_payload_bytes + n8n_execution_id. Block 7 ($5): clickup_attachment_ids = jsonb array combining inline image attachment ids (Rewrite Delta) + office-doc task attachment ids (Append Doc Ops) so an erasure request can delete the ClickUp artifacts this run created. Reuses the sanctioned post-delivery UPDATE (no second agent_runs writer).

nodes.name: Recorded?
nodes.notes: True: clickup_comment_id written (updated=1) -> done. False: no matching agent_runs row (updated=0) -> WARN.

nodes.name: Alert Record Artifact
nodes.notes: WARN when the comment-id write found no row or errored. Defense-in-depth: a missing run row is also alerted upstream by Log Model Run. Posts to the Alerts task (disjoint from the answer task) so no webhook loop; does not block reply/status.

nodes.name: Has Images?
nodes.notes: True: image_manifest non-empty -> in-memory base64 image path. False: text-only path (Build Comment), unchanged from pre-Block-10.

nodes.name: Parse Manifest
nodes.notes: Parses image_manifest (base64 entries: {placeholder_id,b64,mime,caption,alt}) -> one item per image. In-memory (Option A); no disk.

nodes.name: To Binary
nodes.notes: Decodes each manifest base64 string into binary "data" for multipart upload. No file ever touches disk.

nodes.name: Upload Attachment
nodes.notes: Uploads each decoded image to the task -> {id,url}. onError=continueRegularOutput so a failed upload still flows in order (Aggregate substitutes [obraz niedostępny] + WARN).

nodes.name: Aggregate Uploads
nodes.notes: Correlates uploads to manifest by order (1:1). Emits upload_map placeholder_id->{id,url}, attachment_ids, failed_count. One incoming connection only (CLAUDE.md aggregator trap).

nodes.name: Rewrite Delta
nodes.notes: Rewrites {type:image_ref,placeholder_id} -> {type:attachment,attachment:{id,url}} (the ClickUp inline-image op proven in the Block 10 spike). Missing upload -> [obraz niedostępny].

nodes.name: Uploads Failed?
nodes.notes: True: >=1 image upload failed -> WARN (side branch, non-blocking). The comment still posts with [obraz niedostępny] in place of failed images.

value.message: Nie udało się przesłać co najmniej jednego obrazu do ClickUp — komentarz publikuje się z zastępnikiem [obraz niedostępny].

nodes.name: Finalize Comment
nodes.notes: Converges text + image paths. Computes run_payload_bytes = UTF-8 bytes of {rendered_comment,image_manifest} (proxy/lower-bound for execution-data weight; recorded for ALL runs) and appends the Polish size footer line. runOnceForEachItem avoids the multi-incoming aggregator trap.

nodes.name: Has Docs?
nodes.notes: True: doc_attachments non-empty -> office-doc delivery branch (download from Files API, validate, upload to ClickUp task attachment). False: no docs -> straight to Is @mention? (unchanged text/image path). Office-doc OUTPUT files are downloadable from the Files API (Block 0), unlike images. doc_attachments + session_id come from Execute Agent Session's doc_files (Block 8 wiring); the bare lane never sets them so this stays false there.

nodes.name: Get Doc Key
nodes.notes: Reads the anthropic_api_key Vault secret via SECURITY DEFINER getter public.get_anthropic_key() (migration 034) so Download Doc can fetch session output files from the Files API. Same getter Execute Agent Session uses; keeps the key out of the inter-workflow contract. retryOnFail; a hard DB failure throws -> errorWorkflow CRITICAL.

nodes.name: Parse Docs
nodes.notes: Parse doc_attachments ([{file_id,filename,mime}]) -> one item per produced office-doc. Mirrors Parse Manifest for images. Has Docs? guarantees non-empty input.

nodes.name: Download Doc
nodes.notes: GET /v1/files/{file_id}/content (scope_id=session_id, both betas) -> binary `data`. Office-doc OUTPUT files are downloadable (Block 0). onError=continueErrorOutput: a fetch failure (expired/missing/network) -> Build Doc Download Failed -> dropped + WARN, never thrown. Key from Get Doc Key.

nodes.name: Validate Doc
nodes.notes: VALIDATION GATE (Block 7 DoD). Reads each downloaded doc's bytes (binary is filesystem-mode -> getBinaryDataBuffer, not binary.data.data) and asserts structural integrity + the required part is present, WITHOUT a zip library (crypto/zlib unavailable in Code nodes): OOXML (xlsx/docx/pptx) must be a PK ZIP, contain the End-Of-Central-Directory record (PK\x05\x06 -> not truncated), [Content_Types].xml, and the type's required part (xl/workbook.xml | word/document.xml | ppt/presentation.xml — these member names are stored as plaintext in the zip). PDF must start %PDF-, contain %%EOF in the tail, and have /Page. Valid -> pass binary (fileName/mime set) to Upload Doc; invalid -> reason (Polish) -> Build Doc Invalid. Paired-item idiom maps bytes back to Parse Docs meta (mirrors Extract B64).

nodes.name: Doc Valid?
nodes.notes: True: structurally valid -> Upload Doc (binary rides along). False: corrupt/unreadable -> Build Doc Invalid (dropped + WARN + Polish note, never a broken attachment).

nodes.name: Upload Doc
nodes.notes: Uploads each VALID doc to the ClickUp task -> {id,title,url} (reuses the Block-10 attachment-upload pattern). Multipart field `attachment` <- binary data (fileName set by Validate Doc). onError=continueRegularOutput so a failed upload flows on as dropped (Build Doc Uploaded marks it). ClickUp has no delete-attachment API; on partial failure the WARN surfaces orphaned ids.

nodes.name: Build Doc Uploaded
nodes.notes: Normalize an upload outcome -> {ok,id,url,filename,reason}. Success: ClickUp {id,title,url}. Failure (continueRegularOutput): no id -> dropped, reason 'upload'. filename from ClickUp title, fallback to the paired Validate Doc item.

nodes.name: Build Doc Invalid
nodes.notes: Validation-failed branch: the doc is corrupt/unreadable -> dropped with the Polish reason from Validate Doc. Never uploaded (no broken attachment).

parameters.jsCode:
const r = $json || {};
return { json: { ok: false, dropped: true, id: '', url: '', filename: r.filename || 'dokument', reason: r.reason || 'plik uszkodzony' } };

nodes.name: Build Doc Download Failed
nodes.notes: Download error branch (continueErrorOutput): the produced doc could not be fetched from the Files API (expired/missing/network) -> dropped with reason. The error item retains the Parse Docs json (filename/file_id).

nodes.name: Merge Docs
nodes.notes: Converge uploaded (0), invalid (1) and download-failed (2) doc outcomes into ONE stream so Aggregate Docs keeps a single input (CLAUDE.md aggregator trap).

nodes.name: Aggregate Docs
nodes.notes: Reduce doc outcomes -> doc_attachment_ids[] (successful ClickUp ids, for erasure recording), links[{filename,url}] (for the comment), dropped[{filename,reason}], and a single consolidated WARN if anything was dropped. One incoming connection only.

nodes.name: Append Doc Ops
nodes.notes: Append a 'Załączniki' section to Finalize Comment's ops: a link line per delivered doc and a Polish note per dropped doc. Re-reads Finalize Comment's ops (absolute ref) and carries doc_attachment_ids forward for Record Artifact. Feeds Is @mention? ($json.ops is what Post Reply/Post Draft post).

nodes.name: Docs Dropped?
nodes.notes: True: >=1 doc dropped (corrupt/download/upload) -> WARN (side branch, non-blocking). The comment still posts with the delivered docs + Polish notes for the dropped ones.

nodes.name: Alert Docs Dropped
nodes.notes: WARN via the centralized Post Alert (v1) seam when an office-doc could not be delivered (validation/download/upload). Side branch; does not block the comment.

nodes.name: Get Spend Status
nodes.notes: ADR-064 end-of-message warning: get_spend_status(reviewer_user_id) at reply time (post-run -> the just-finished run's cost is already counted). Finalize Comment appends a Polish warning line when warn=true (>60% user / >70% company). onError continueRegularOutput + alwaysOutputData so a DB miss just omits the warning, never blocks the reply. Covers both lanes since both call Post Reply (v1).
